text: To do the necessary in every season (such as growing crops in spring and reaping harvest in autumn), to do the utmost to make lands as fertile as possible, and to be frugal in their expense, in order to keep their parents in comfort, is the filial duty of the common people.
author: Confucius and Zengzi
reference: The Classic of Filial Piety (Xiao Jing)
locator: Chapter VI, The Filial Duty of Common People
